summary: HSBC filed a 6-K reporting daily purchases under its buy-back announced 5 August 2026. On 17 September 2026 it bought 505,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.1862 and 312,400 shares in Hong Kong at HK$159.0793, via BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC, for cancellation. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 36,208,497 shares for approximately US$745.9 million; issued ordinary share capital and total voting rights stand at 17,149,199,100, with no shares held in treasury. Watch execution pace versus the announced programme size and residual buy-back capacity.
